assessments.comment: Independent inspection-only assessment using frozen cohort remodnav-e3c6253bced7 and assigned rubric revision e8d94d00d904058b8f87c8331cbe32e225a9490f. Manifest SHA256 verified. Source, histories and metadata inspected; no network calls, payload acquisition, scientific execution or container build. Historical exit-0 records are evidence of recorded past runs, not independent reproduction. Missing payload bytes limit retrieval and access-condition findings. The private raw lab-source submodule is not needed to consume selected processed gaze inputs. No peer results or worked examples consulted. Scores describe STAMPED fulfillment only. Inspection report completed; native criterion completion is 34/36 with M-05 and D-01 unanswered, retaining fixed denominators.
